text:
emma (Partnerships): Quick shoutout — Aurum Systems just published our Redwood SDK connector in their partner developer portal and confirmed we’ll be bundled in their enterprise image for their Q2 pilot :tada:

kyle (Sales): Incredible! Any commitment size or pilot SLAs we should track?

maria (Partner Success): They signed a 6-month pilot (internal note: key account for Dedicated customers). I'll own onboarding. Need assets & SSO docs.

emma (Partnerships): Pilot terms: 6 months, up to 50k tokens/day initially, option to move to Dedicated later. They want SSO + token rotation + a short integration guide.

aj (Engineering): For SSO they asked for SAML metadata and service-account provisioning. Tech details: they're planning to call our SDK with `token_rotation` enabled and will use our streaming path. Can we get a sample `redwood.toml` snippet?

emma (Partnerships): @aj can you drop a minimal config snippet and a short install line we can hand to Aurum?

aj (Engineering): Yep, quick example:
```
# install
pip install redwood-sdk-connector==0.9.2

# minimal config
[redwood]
api_key = "<REDACTED>"
mode = "dedicated"
```
I'll follow up with SAML metadata template.

sarah (Marketing): Love this — can we queue up a partner spotlight? Prefer to wait until pilot starts, but want a short customer quote and an architecture diagram. @maria can you capture a 1-2 line quote during kickoff? :camera_with_flash:

maria (Partner Success): Will do. Also requesting integration checklist and a dedicated Slack channel with Aurum engineers. Their lead is @ben.aurum (external).

emma (Partnerships): Created private channel `#aurum-integration` and invited core folks. I'll send the press cadence doc — marketing wants to coordinate on any joint announcement.

aurum-integration-bot: webhook test OK — connector install ping successful from aurum-ci at 2025-08-12T14:20:03Z

kyle (Sales): Marking this in CRM as `Partner Integration — Pilot` and tagging ARR motion. I'll loop in AE for renewals strategy.

sarah (Marketing): Drafting a one-pager and a short blog outline. Will share draft in `#partner-content` tomorrow.

emma (Partnerships): Huge team win — thank you all. Next steps: (1) aj: SAML + config snippet by EOD, (2) maria: kickoff + quote next week, (3) sarah: draft collateral by Tue. I'll update the tracker after kickoff. :rocket:
